name: openrag_bench
description: OpenRAG Bench evaluates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems on open-domain question answering where models must retrieve relevant documents and generate accurate answers. It measures how well different retrieval+generation pipelines produce precise, factual responses given a query and supporting context. The benchmark focuses on end-to-end RAG performance rather than isolated retrieval or generation components.
reputation: Niche, used by researchers experimenting with retrieval-augmented generation; limited but growing adoption in RAG research.
